rule: Review the current upstream before deciding whether to update, distill, exclude, or implement. A newer HEAD is not automatic admission.

entries.reason: The changes contain substantial PPTX fidelity, native object reconstruction, layout-contract, UTF-8, and first-page quality-gate fixes that directly improve the retained editable-deck capability.
Retain the complete cold package, but expose only its newer design-reasoning and execution-guard behavior through the 2.0 presentation and visual scenarios.
The update fixes template YAML and documentation. It is worth pinning as a cold source but does not justify a larger runtime surface.

The new upstream is an independent daemon, authentication, provider, library, and agent platform. Importing it would recreate a second host and control surface; the previously bounded taste evidence remains optional until separately re-evaluated.
